selection_review.reason: Examined against the O1 bar on its metal-parts-and-forgings row, the same link this run promotes ATI-INC on (evidence VERIFIED, link EMERGING, CHOKE_POINT). All 11 canonical fields are filled with zero NULL, revenue.latest_fy VERIFIED and cash-conversion official_source true (satisfies the O1 cross-check on the numbers alone), and Howmet's own fundamentals are strong (24.8% operating margin, 13.4% 3y revenue CAGR, Piotroski 8, Beneish -2.543 CLEAN) -- a genuinely close call. Held at O2 rather than promoted alongside ATI-INC for duplicate economic exposure: both sit on the identical CHOKE_POINT link (the Mesquite projectile-metal-parts qualification bottleneck), both are specialty-metals forgings suppliers to the same aerospace-and-defense customer set, and the placement evidence for Howmet describes titanium/aluminium aerospace-and-defense structural work broadly rather than naming Howmet specifically in the missile/munitions context the way ATI's own evidence does (ATI's first-quarter missile revenue doubling, named directly in the chain's heat evidence). Promoting both would stack two near-identical specialty-metals bets on one link; ATI-INC's more specific, named, quantified defense exposure (68% Aerospace & Defense, double-digit defense growth, explicit missile-programme naming) was the deciding factor between two otherwise comparable clean profiles.
selection_review.revisit: Revisit if a future run finds Howmet-specific missile/munitions revenue disclosure (rather than broad aerospace-and-defense language) that distinguishes it from ATI-INC's exposure, or if the theme's O1 ceiling is raised, or if ATI-INC's own promotion is later reversed.
